title: Pure Butterspy
summary: Butterspy is a Level 4 Warrior Rank 4 Xyz archetype played by Dextra that changes opposing monsters' battle positions and reduces their ATK to 0. Blue Mountain Butterspy and Moonlit Papillon swarm the board with Level 4 Warriors, enabling quick Xyz Summons into Photon Papilloperative, Photon Alexandra Queen, and Heroic Champion Rank 4s.

allow.Goblindbergh: Level 4 Warrior that Special Summons a Level 4 Butterspy from hand and switches to Defense Position, triggering Blue Mountain Butterspy.
allow.Kagetokage: Special Summons itself when you Normal Summon a Level 4 Butterspy to facilitate 3-material Rank 4 Xyz Summons.
allow.Photon Thrasher: Special Summons itself when you control no monsters as a Level 4 Warrior to enable quick Rank 4 plays.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches any Level 4 Butterspy Warrior monster from the Deck.
allow.Heroic Champion - Excalibur: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that detaches 2 materials to double its ATK to 4000 against 0 ATK monsters.
allow.Blade Armor Ninja: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that detaches 1 material to attack twice per Battle Phase.

main: Cannot be Normal Summoned; Special Summons itself from the hand whenever you Normal Summon a Warrior monster.
Special Summons a Level 4 or lower 'Butterspy' monster from the Deck whenever it is sent from the field to the GY.
Reduces the ATK and DEF of an opponent's monster by 1000 whenever the battle position of an opponent's monster is changed.
Changes an opponent's monster to Defense Position when another monster you control inflicts battle damage to the opponent.
Level 4 Warrior extender from hand that sets up Rank 4 plays.
Summons Moonlit Papillon or Morpho Butterspy from hand while simultaneously triggering Blue Mountain Butterspy in hand.
Level 4 extender that pairs with Normal Summoned Butterspies and Blue Mountain Butterspy for 3-material Rank 4s.
Changes an opponent's Attack Position monster to Defense Position and halves battle damage.
Searches Blue Mountain Butterspy, Moonlit Papillon, or Goblindbergh.
extra: Signature Rank 4 Xyz that changes a Defense Position monster to face-up Attack Position and reduces its ATK by 600.
Signature Rank 4 Xyz made with 2 Butterspy monsters that bounces all monsters on the field to the hand and burns for 300 per returned card.
Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that reaches 4000 ATK to finish off monsters weakened by Papilloperative and Morpho Butterspy.
Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that attacks twice to repeatedly trigger Swallowtail Butterspy.
